supporting_features.feature_phrase: loose filament spread across the build plate
supporting_features.evidence: Thin deposited strands lie across a broad area of the plate instead of forming one compact upright object.
Numerous strands curl into irregular loops and overlap within the visible material mass.

supporting_features.feature_phrase: long strands trailing from the main cluster
supporting_features.evidence: Several individual filaments extend away from the denser central cluster across the plate surface.

supporting_features.feature_phrase: absence of a coherent anchored footprint
supporting_features.evidence: The visible deposit consists of separated strands and low irregular patches without a continuous solid base outline.
